message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which charge(s) from the lexicon apply to the fact.

Fact: Chen Mou rented a supermarket space, opened clothing processing factory, employed workers, owed wages 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, escaped, refused to pay. Labor bureau sent notice to pay by June 27, 2016, still not paid. Later paid 51,000 RMB, remaining owed with IOU.

Thus the crime is "refusal to pay labor remuneration" which in lexicon is "拒不支付劳动报酬". Also possibly "拒不执行判决、裁定"? He was ordered to pay by administrative order, but not a judgment. The lexicon includes "拒不执行判决、裁定" (refusal to execute judgment or ruling). The fact: He was ordered by labor bureau to pay, but that's an administrative order, not a judgment. The charge "拒不支付劳动报酬" directly matches.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>

Check if any other charges: maybe "拖欠工资" is covered by that. So single charge.

Thus final answer.
